senses.gloss:
न + -एक^1 a.
—1 ‘not one’, more than one, several, various; नैकः सुप्तेषु जागृयात् Viduranīti.
—2 Not anyone, nobody; नैको मुनिर्यस्य वचः प्रमाणम् Pt.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/5f7cee5.

नैक a. [न-एक]
—1 Not one or alone (mostly in comp.); नैको मुनिर्यस्य वचः प्रमाणम्.
—2 Various, manifold; नैकरागस्फुरितमणिरुचः Mu. 3. 19. See under
 न. ˚आत्मन् m., ˚रूपः, ˚शृगः epithets of the Supreme Being.

न + -एकः + .({@-कः@}) an epithet of Viṣṇu. ˚आत्मन् a. of a manifold
 or diverse nature. ━(m.) N. of the Supreme Being. ˚चर a.
 ‘not living alone’, gregarious, living in society. ˚जः the Supreme
 Being. ˚धा ind. in many ways, diversely. ˚भेद, ˚रूप a.
 various, multiform.

नैक + .{@-कः@} An epithet of Viṣṇu.
.━{@Comp.@}: नैककोटिसारः, नैकचर, नैकभावाश्रय, नैकभेद

नैक + -कोटिसारः a millionaire, one possessing crores of rupees (Mar.
 कोठ्यधीश).

नैक + -चर a. living in society, gregarious; नैकचर एकचरो
 वा भक्षयति Bhāg. 5. 8. 18.
नैक + -भेद a. manifold, various. See under न also.
नैकधा ind. In various ways, variously.

नैकशस् ind.
—1 In great numbers.
—2 Repeatedly, often, frequently.

नैकटिक a. (-क्री f.)
 Adjacent, near, contiguous.

नैकटिक + .{@-कः@} An ascetic or Bhikṣu; (vide commentary ‘ग्रामस्यान्तिके क्रोशमानं त्यक्त्वा यतयो भिक्षवो ये निवसन्ति ते नैकटिकाः’,
 on पर्षद्बलान्
 महाब्रह्मैराट नैकटिकाश्रमान् Bk. 4. 12.)

नैकट्यम्^1 Proximity, neighbourhood.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170203. note: neuter noun.

नैकृतिक a. (-की f.)
—1 Dishonest, false (or perhaps cruel); अधोदृष्टिर्नैकृतिकः स्वार्थसाधनतत्परः
 Ms. 4. 196; Bg. 18. 28.
—2 Low, vile, wicked; Rām. 4. 17. 43.
—3 Morose.
